brush_writing_fine_art.name: Brush-writing as Fine Art
brush_writing_fine_art.observation: Collectors prize a master's brushed characters as highly as paintings, and students copy his strokes for years.

holy_tomb_pilgrimage.name: Tomb Pilgrimage
holy_tomb_pilgrimage.observation: Pilgrims walk for weeks to pray at the tombs of the god's servants and bring home a flask of oil from the lamps.

holy_relic_shrines.name: Relic Shrines
holy_relic_shrines.observation: The bones of the god's servants are kept in shrines of silver, and oaths sworn on them are feared.

confessional_autobiography.name: Confessional Life
confessional_autobiography.observation: A servant of the god writes his own life as a confession of his faults, spoken to the god himself.

providential_world_history.name: World History as the God's Plan
providential_world_history.observation: Chroniclers tell the history of all peoples as one story moving by the god's plan toward its end.

holy_servants_feast_year.name: Feast Year of the God's Servants
holy_servants_feast_year.observation: Every day of the year belongs to one of the god's servants, and the greater ones bring a feast and a day of rest.

rock_cut_cave_sanctuaries.name: Cave Sanctuaries
rock_cut_cave_sanctuaries.observation: Halls and shrines are cut into a cliff face and painted with the god's stories from floor to ceiling.

devotee_communities_under_rule.name: Devotees Under a Rule
devotee_communities_under_rule.observation: Devotees live together under a written rule that sets their hours of prayer, work in the fields and reading.
devotee_communities_under_rule.ability_reason: Devotees live together under a written rule of prayer, work and reading; their houses farm, copy and shelter travellers when the towns fail.
devotee_communities_under_rule.social_consequence: Many sons and daughters leave their families for the house of the rule

official_ivory_diptychs.name: Ivory Office Panels
official_ivory_diptychs.observation: A new official sends carved ivory panels bearing his portrait and titles to his friends and patrons.

venerated_icons.name: Venerated Icons
venerated_icons.observation: Painted images of the god's servants are kissed, carried in procession and credited with saving the town.

race_faction_parties.name: Race Factions Sway Rulers
race_faction_parties.observation: The circus factions have their own colours, officers and quarters, and their riots can topple a minister.
race_faction_parties.social_consequence: Street factions riot for their charioteers and can unseat a minister

stanza_hymn_sermons.name: Sung Stanza Sermons
stanza_hymn_sermons.observation: A preacher sings his sermon in stanzas, and the whole crowd answers each one with the refrain.

great_domed_temple.name: Great Domed Temple
great_domed_temple.observation: A brick dome rises on four great arches over a hall wider than any before, lit by a ring of windows at its base.
great_domed_temple.ability_reason: A dome on four arches spans the greatest hall of the realm; the god's house outshines every palace, and the ruler's piety is set in stone.
great_domed_temple.social_consequence: Masons and labourers from half the realm are called to the god's great house

peoples_origin_histories.name: Origin Histories of Peoples
peoples_origin_histories.observation: Each newcomer people has its history written from its wandering ancestors to its present kings.

chant_schools.name: Chant Schools
chant_schools.observation: Boys are trained for years in a chant school to sing the god's rites from memory.

strategy_board_war_game.name: War Board Game
strategy_board_war_game.observation: Two players move foot, horse, chariot and elephant on a checkered board to trap the other's king.

mead_hall_gift_feasts.name: Hall Gift Feasts
mead_hall_gift_feasts.observation: In the lord's hall the warriors drink, the poet sings their deeds and the lord hands out rings.

lantern_festival_nights.name: Lantern Festival
lantern_festival_nights.observation: On the first full moon of the year the streets hang with lanterns and the curfew is lifted for three nights.

devotional_songs_common_tongue.name: Devotional Songs
devotional_songs_common_tongue.observation: Wandering singers make songs of love for the god in the everyday tongue that anyone can learn.

warband_heroic_poems.name: Warband Heroic Poems
warband_heroic_poems.observation: Poets sing the deeds of the warband's heroes in the everyday tongue, in lines bound by alliteration.

interlace_illuminated_books.name: Interlace Illumination
interlace_illuminated_books.observation: Painters fill whole pages of the god's books with knotwork, spirals and beasts twisted together.

regulated_tonal_verse.name: Regulated Tonal Verse
regulated_tonal_verse.observation: Poets write eight-line verses in which the tones of each word and the matched couplets follow fixed rules.

image_breaking_dispute.name: Dispute Over Images
image_breaking_dispute.observation: One party smashes the painted images of the god's servants, and the other hides them and paints them again.
image_breaking_dispute.social_consequence: Image-breakers and image-keepers fight over the walls of the god's house

court_learning_revival.name: Court Revival of Learning
court_learning_revival.observation: The court gathers scholars from abroad, has the old books copied in a clear hand, and orders schools opened.
court_learning_revival.ability_reason: The court gathers scholars, has the old books copied and orders schools opened; learning that had withered is revived by command.

carved_story_stones.name: Carved Story Stones
carved_story_stones.observation: Tall stones carved with scenes of the god's story stand at crossroads and meeting places.

terraced_temple_mountain.name: Temple Mountain
terraced_temple_mountain.observation: Terrace upon terrace of carved stone rises like a mountain, and pilgrims climb it past the god's stories.

neume_chant_notation.name: Neume Notation
neume_chant_notation.observation: Small signs written over the words show where the chant rises and falls.
neume_chant_notation.ability_reason: Signs over the words show the rise and fall of the chant; distant choirs sing the god's praise alike without learning every chant by ear.

mirror_for_rulers.name: Mirror for Rulers
mirror_for_rulers.observation: Advice books tell a young ruler how to judge, whom to trust and how to fear the god.

ruler_biography.name: Life of the Ruler
ruler_biography.observation: A courtier writes the ruler's life, his wars, habits and death, in the manner of the old biographies.

frame_story_collections.name: Frame-story Collections
frame_story_collections.observation: A storyteller keeps her life by telling one tale each night, and each tale holds another.

liturgical_drama.name: Plays Within the Rites
liturgical_drama.observation: At the great feast the servants of the god act the story in the god's house, speaking in turn.

court_poetry_contests.name: Court Poetry Contests
court_poetry_contests.observation: Courtiers compose poems on a set theme, and judges rank them before the ruler.

many_voice_singing.name: Many-voice Singing
many_voice_singing.observation: A second voice sings the chant a fifth below the first, and a third joins it on the great feasts.

coronation_regalia_rite.name: Crowning Rite and Regalia
coronation_regalia_rite.observation: A written rite sets out the anointing, the crown, the orb and the staff, and the oath the ruler must speak.
coronation_regalia_rite.ability_reason: A written rite fixes the crown, orb, staff and oath; every crowning follows the same form, so a new ruler's title cannot be questioned for want of it.

great_pipe_organs.name: Great Pipe Organs
great_pipe_organs.observation: A great organ of hundreds of pipes, blown by many bellows men, fills the god's house with sound.

printed_playing_cards.name: Playing Cards
printed_playing_cards.observation: Printed card packs of suits and courts sell in the markets, and townsmen gamble in the inns.

kin_memorial_stones.name: Kin Memorial Stones
kin_memorial_stones.observation: Families raise carved stones for kinsmen who died trading or raiding abroad, naming them and where they fell.

shadow_puppet_theatre.name: Shadow Puppets
shadow_puppet_theatre.observation: Puppets of painted hide cast their shadows on a lit screen while the master speaks every part.

court_psychological_novel.name: Court Novel
court_psychological_novel.observation: A lady of the court writes a long tale of love and rivalry told through its people's thoughts.

book_of_kings_epic.name: Book of Kings
book_of_kings_epic.observation: One poet spends his life setting every king of the realm in verse in the common tongue, from the first ruler onward.
book_of_kings_epic.ability_reason: The realm's kings are set in verse in the common tongue; the people's history is sung by everyone instead of being held by the learned.

staff_line_notation.name: Staff Notation
staff_line_notation.observation: Notes are written on ruled lines with a clef, so every pitch is fixed on the page.
staff_line_notation.ability_reason: Lines and clefs fix every pitch; a singer can sing a new melody from the page without ever having heard it.

monumental_landscape_painting.name: Landscape Scrolls
monumental_landscape_painting.observation: Painters set towering mountains, streams and tiny travellers on hanging scrolls taller than a man.

round_arch_great_houses.name: Round-arch Great Houses
round_arch_great_houses.observation: Thick walls, round arches and small windows raise a stone great house of the god in town after town.
round_arch_great_houses.ability_reason: Stone great houses with round arches rise in every town; the god's house dominates each skyline and keeps masons in standing lodges.

embroidered_conquest_hangings.name: Conquest Hangings
embroidered_conquest_hangings.observation: Women embroider a long hanging that tells, scene by scene, how the ruler's army crossed the sea and won.

pleasure_quarter_storytellers.name: Pleasure-quarter Storytellers
pleasure_quarter_storytellers.observation: In the pleasure quarters, storytellers, jugglers and players perform under awnings until late at night.

pilgrim_road_badges.name: Pilgrim Roads and Badges
pilgrim_road_badges.observation: Hostels line the pilgrim roads a day apart, and pilgrims come home with a lead badge of the shrine on their hats.

armed_pilgrimage_preaching.name: Armed Pilgrimage
armed_pilgrimage_preaching.observation: The god's servants preach that warriors who take the pilgrim's sign and fight for the holy places are forgiven.
armed_pilgrimage_preaching.social_consequence: Armed pilgrims take the sign and leave their fields and families for years

champion_deed_songs.name: Champion Songs
champion_deed_songs.observation: Singers chant the deeds of a champion who died holding a pass against a great army.

courtly_love_lyric.name: Courtly Love Songs
courtly_love_lyric.observation: Travelling poets sing of loving a noble lady from afar, in the everyday tongue, at court after court.
courtly_love_lyric.ability_reason: Travelling poets carry love songs in the common tongue from court to court; a shared manner of courtesy spreads among the nobles of many realms.

sculpted_portal_programs.name: Carved Portals
sculpted_portal_programs.observation: Over the great doors, carved figures show the god's judgement to everyone who passes beneath.

moralized_bestiaries.name: Moral Bestiaries
moralized_bestiaries.observation: A book of beasts pictures the lion, the pelican and the unicorn, and draws a lesson from each.

knightly_conduct_code.name: Knightly Code
knightly_conduct_code.observation: Mounted warriors are taught to keep faith, give freely, spare a yielded foe and protect the weak.
knightly_conduct_code.ability_reason: Mounted warriors swear to a code of loyalty, largesse and mercy to the yielded; a general can count on his vassals' honour as well as their oaths.

heraldic_arms.name: Heraldic Arms
heraldic_arms.observation: Each noble house bears its own colours and figures on shield and banner, and sons inherit them.
heraldic_arms.ability_reason: Noble houses bear inherited arms on shield and banner; a general can see which lord holds which ground in battle.

pointed_arch_glass_temples.name: Pointed-arch Glass Great Houses
pointed_arch_glass_temples.observation: Pointed arches and outside buttresses lift the walls into tall windows of coloured glass.
pointed_arch_glass_temples.ability_reason: Pointed arches and buttresses turn walls into coloured glass; each town raises a great house over generations under standing masters' lodges.
pointed_arch_glass_temples.social_consequence: Whole towns give their labour and coin to the great house for generations

ink_wash_painting.name: Ink-wash Painting
ink_wash_painting.observation: Painters work in black ink alone, wet and dry, to catch mist, bamboo and mountains in a few strokes.

beast_epic_satire.name: Beast Epic Satire
beast_epic_satire.observation: The fox cheats the lion, the wolf and the god's servants in a long comic tale everyone knows is about the great.

poor_devout_dissent.name: Poor Devout Movements
poor_devout_dissent.observation: Townsfolk give away their goods and preach that the god's servants should own nothing.
poor_devout_dissent.social_consequence: The poor devout preach that the god's house should own nothing

chivalric_romance.name: Chivalric Romance
chivalric_romance.observation: Romances tell of knights who ride out alone on quests for love, honour and the god's wonders.

polyphonic_choirbooks.name: Polyphonic Choirbooks
polyphonic_choirbooks.observation: Choirbooks large enough for a whole choir to read at once hold great works for four voices.

wandering_scholar_songs.name: Wandering Scholar Songs
wandering_scholar_songs.observation: Wandering students sing drinking songs and mock the greed of the god's senior servants.

wandering_preacher_orders.name: Preaching Orders
wandering_preacher_orders.observation: Barefoot preachers of the new orders live by alms and preach in the town squares in the everyday tongue.
wandering_preacher_orders.ability_reason: Orders of wandering preachers live by alms and preach in the squares in the common tongue; the god's word reaches crowds the great houses never gathered.
wandering_preacher_orders.social_consequence: Preachers in the square can raise a crowd for the god's house or against its enemies

family_prose_sagas.name: Family Sagas
family_prose_sagas.observation: Prose sagas tell of farming families, their lawsuits and feuds over generations.

sacred_world_maps.name: World Maps of the God's Order
sacred_world_maps.observation: A great round map sets the holy city at the centre and paradise at the top, with every people in its place.

carnival_misrule.name: Carnival
carnival_misrule.observation: Before the fast, a mock king rules the town, masks are worn and the great are mocked for a few days.
carnival_misrule.social_consequence: For a few days the town mocks its betters, and the next week the fast begins

guild_patron_feasts.name: Guild Patron Feasts
guild_patron_feasts.observation: Each guild feasts on the day of its patron servant of the god and pays for a candle in the god's house.

measured_rhythm_notation.name: Measured Rhythm Notation
measured_rhythm_notation.observation: The shape of each note now shows how long it lasts, as well as how high.

recumbent_tomb_effigies.name: Tomb Effigies
recumbent_tomb_effigies.observation: A lord and his lady lie carved in stone on their tomb, their hands joined in prayer.

private_devotion_books.name: Books of Hours
private_devotion_books.observation: A small painted book of prayers for each hour of the day belongs to one household.

ruler_town_entries.name: Royal Entries
ruler_town_entries.observation: When the ruler enters a town, its guilds build arches, stage tableaux and hand him the keys.

jubilee_pilgrimage_year.name: Jubilee Year
jubilee_pilgrimage_year.observation: The head of the god's house proclaims a year of pardon for all who come to the holy city.

naturalistic_fresco_cycles.name: Lifelike Fresco Cycles
naturalistic_fresco_cycles.observation: Painters give figures weight, shadow and grief on the walls of the god's houses and town halls.
naturalistic_fresco_cycles.ability_reason: Painters give figures weight, depth and feeling on the walls; the god's story and the town's pride are shown as if witnessed.

vernacular_allegory_epic.name: Allegorical Journey Poem
vernacular_allegory_epic.observation: A poet journeys in verse through the realms of the god's judgement, in the everyday tongue of his town.
vernacular_allegory_epic.ability_reason: A great allegorical poem in the everyday tongue journeys through the god's judgement; the common tongue proves it can carry the highest learning.

guild_cycle_plays.name: Guild Cycle Plays
guild_cycle_plays.observation: Each guild stages one scene of the god's story on a wagon, and the wagons roll through the town in turn.

vernacular_town_chronicles.name: Town Chronicles
vernacular_town_chronicles.observation: A merchant writes his town's chronicle in the everyday tongue, with prices, floods and council quarrels.

chivalric_orders_insignia.name: Knightly Orders
chivalric_orders_insignia.observation: The ruler founds a knightly order with a badge and a feast day, and its companions sit at his side.

sonnet_sequences.name: Sonnet Sequences
sonnet_sequences.observation: A poet writes hundreds of fourteen-line poems to one beloved, alive and then dead.

old_text_recovery.name: Recovery of Old Texts
old_text_recovery.observation: Scholars search forgotten book rooms of the retreat houses for old works lost for centuries.

penitent_processions.name: Penitent Processions
penitent_processions.observation: Bands of penitents walk from town to town, scourging themselves to turn away the pestilence.
penitent_processions.social_consequence: Crowds of penitents carry the pestilence from town to town

townsfolk_tale_collections.name: Hundred Tales
townsfolk_tale_collections.observation: Ten young townsfolk, fleeing the pestilence, tell a hundred tales of merchants, lovers and tricked priests.

dance_of_death_images.name: Dance of Death
dance_of_death_images.observation: A painted wall shows death leading the ruler, the merchant and the ploughman alike in one dance.
